title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team in Bangalore. As an engineer, you will help design, build, and operate core messaging and caching services that our product teams rely on to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable experiences to customers worldwide. You will work with senior engineers and managers to implement platform features, improve reliability and performance, and build tooling and libraries that make it easy for product teams to adopt best‑practice eventing and caching patterns.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to a Senior Engineering Manager in Cloud \& Production Engineering.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design, implement, and test features in our events, cache, and queues platform, under the guidance of senior engineers
* Contribute to internal client libraries and SDKs that standardize how Docusign services interact with Azure Service Bus, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Kafka, Redis, and related platforms
* Help improve the reliability and performance of messaging and caching systems by implementing metrics, logging, and tracing for critical paths, participating in root‑cause analysis (RCA) discussions and follow‑up fixes, and automating runbooks and operational tasks where possible
* Collaborate with teammates to review designs and code, share feedback, and learn best practices for distributed systems and event‑driven architectures
* Write unit, integration, and functional tests to ensure high quality and maintainability of code
* Work with SRE and partner engineering teams to roll out changes safely, including canary deployments, feature flags, and configuration management
* Learn and follow secure coding practices, including proper handling of secrets, credentials, and access to messaging and cache resources
* Participate in team rituals (standups, planning, retrospectives) and contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a BE/BTech, ME/MTech, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* Strong foundation in computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and problem solving
* Programming experience in at least one object‑oriented or systems language such as Java, C\#, Python or Go
* Familiarity with basic concepts in distributed systems (for example, client‑server, latency, throughput, retries) and networking (for example, HTTP, TCP/IP)
* Comfort with Linux or another UNIX‑like operating system and command‑line tools
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment


**Preferred**
* Internship or project experience building backend services, microservices, or APIs
* Exposure to messaging or streaming systems (for example, Azure Service Bus, Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ) or caching systems (for example, Redis, Memcached), through coursework, projects, or internships
* Experience with either Cloud platforms such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS, or Containers (Docker) and basic CI/CD tooling, or writing automated tests and using version control (Git)
* Demonstrated interest in reliability and performance (for example, course projects, hackathons, or personal projects related to distributed systems or infrastructure)
* A growth mindset and eagerness to learn from feedback, mentors, and teammates


 Life at Docusign

 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 A fast\-scaling tech innovator in the SaaS and digital transformation space, we build intuitive, high\-performance web applications that empower enterprises and startups to digitize workflows, enhance user engagement, and scale operations seamlessly. Our frontend team owns the user experience layer of flagship products—combining modern UI/UX best practices with scalable architecture to deliver pixel\-perfect, accessible, and blazing\-fast interfaces for global users.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Design and implement responsive, component\-driven frontend interfaces using React.js or Vue.js, ensuring cross\-browser compatibility and mobile\-first responsiveness.
* Collaborate with UX designers to translate wireframes and prototypes into production\-ready UIs with attention to micro\-interactions and accessibility standards.
* Optimize application performance by leveraging code\-splitting, lazy loading, and modern bundling strategies to reduce load times and improve LCP/CLS metrics.
* Integrate RESTful and GraphQL APIs to power dynamic, data\-rich UIs while managing state efficiently using Redux, Zustand, or Vue Pinia.
* Write unit and integration tests using Jest, React Testing Library, or Vitest to ensure reliability and maintainability of frontend components.
* Partner with backend engineers and QA to ship features rapidly while upholding code quality, documentation, and CI/CD best practices.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Must\-Have**
* React.js
* JavaScript (ES6\+)
* HTML5
* CSS3 (including Flexbox, Grid)
* REST API
* Git
* Webpack
* Responsive Design


**Preferred**
* Next.js
* GraphQL
* TypeScript


**Benefits \& Culture Highlights**
* Flat hierarchy with direct access to product and tech leadership for rapid feedback and growth.
* Hybrid work model with flexible hours post onboarding (initially on\-site in India).
* Quarterly hackathons, skill\-up grants, and dedicated time for open\-source or learning initiatives.

Location: Pune  
Company: Modma Games (by Modmacon)  
Type: Full\-Time Experience: 1 to 3 years (Fresher with good portfolio and skillset would also do)

About Modmacon  
Modmacon is a global game production studio working with some of the world’s top developers to create bold, stylized, and deeply playable gaming experiences. We bring speed, scale, and soul to everything we touch — from game art and animation to creative storytelling and marketing.

Role Overview  
We’re on the lookout for a Video Editor to join our Marketing team. If you're someone who can turn footage into engaging visual stories, stay on top of trends, and bring creative campaigns to life — this one's for you. Graphic design will be a secondary, supporting part of your role.

What You’ll Do �  
Primary: Video Editing  
● Conceptualize and edit high\-quality videos for social media, YouTube, and internal branding  
● Create reels, shorts, teasers, behind\-the\-scenes content, and team highlights  
● Edit with a strong sense of narrative, pace, and platform\-specific formats  
● Add transitions, subtitles, motion graphics, and music to elevate content  
● Maintain a consistent visual style that reflects Modmacon’s brand identity

Secondary: Graphic Design (Support Function)  
● Assist with graphic needs like thumbnails, social media templates, and campaign creatives ● Support the team with static/motion design for decks, internal branding, or merch visuals ● Collaborate with content writers and designers to align visual and narrative elements

What We’re Looking For  
● Around 2 years of hands\-on experience in video editing  
● Strong portfolio showcasing a variety of edited content (especially for social platforms)  
● Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects; knowledge of Photoshop/Illustrator is a plus

title: HR Partner, Ops Field HRP
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. **Responsibilities**
* System Reliability: Ensuring the reliability of software systems by designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and reliable infrastructure.
* Automation: Developing automation tools and scripts to streamline operational tasks, reduce manual intervention, and improve overall system efficiency.
* Incident Response and Resolution: Monitoring system performance and responding to incidents promptly to minimize downtime and ensure high availability.
* Capacity Planning: Analyzing system usage patterns and forecasting future capacity needs to ensure that the infrastructure can handle current and future demands.
* Performance Optimization: Identifying and addressing performance bottlenecks in software systems through optimization and tuning.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implementing infrastructure as code practices, using tools like Terraform or Ansible, to define and manage infrastructure in a version\-controlled and automated manner.
* Monitoring and Logging: Implementing and maintaining monitoring and logging solutions to gain insights into system behavior, troubleshoot issues, and proactively address potential problems.
* On\-Call Support: Participating in an on\-call rotation to respond to incidents outside of regular working hours and ensure 24/7 system availability
* Security: Collaborating with security teams to implement and maintain security best practices in infrastructure and application
* Disaster Recovery Planning: Developing and maintaining disaster recovery plans to ensure that systems can quickly recover from major outages or failures
* Continuous Improvement: Continuously analyzing system performance, reliability, and incidents to identify areas for improvement and implementing changes to enhance overall system resilience.


**Skills**
* Programming Languages: Proficiency in one or more programming languages, commonly Python, Go, Shell, Bash.
* Automation and Scripting: Strong automation skills using tools like Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or custom scripts. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform
* Containerization and Orchestration: Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Cloud Computing: Proficiency in any of the cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and knowledge of managing infrastructure in the cloud.
* Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack) and logging frameworks to track system performance and troubleshoot issues.
* Networking: Understanding of networking concepts, protocols, and troubleshooting skills.
* Security: Knowledge of security best practices, including encryption, access controls, and vulnerability management.
* Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Understanding and implementation of CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.
* Load Balancing: Experience in incident response, troubleshooting, and resolution.
* Version Control: Proficient use of version control systems like Git.

* 2\-4 years of experience in site reliability engineering.
* B.Tech/M.Tech in computer science, information technology or a related field.
* Having experience working for a product organization is a plus.
* Certifications from cloud service providers like AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, or Microsoft Certified is a plus

title: Cyber Security Engineer I - Solution Architecture, Security Scoping & Automation
description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a technically driven and versatile Cyber Security Engineer to join FICO's Cyber Security Trust Team, focused on customer onboarding security. This role sits at the intersection of security engineering, software development, solution architecture review, and AI, making it a uniquely hands\-on and high\-impact position within FICO's security organization.The engineer will be responsible for performing end\-to\-end security scoping for customer onboarding projects by reviewing Solution Architecture \& Design Documents (SADDs), identifying security risks and requirements. Given that customer solutions involve complex cloud\-hosted platforms, REST APIs, orchestration workflows, and multi\-component microservice architectures, the engineer must be expert in coding, building automation scripts, and working with AI\-driven workflows to perform thorough and accurate security assessments.
   

  

**What You’ll Contribute**
* Develop Python/Shell security automation scripts and CI/CD\-integrated workflows (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD).
* Perform secure code reviews across Python, Shell, Java, REST/JSON APIs, and automate vulnerability management/compliance tasks.
* Build secure IaC solutions for cloud provisioning and collaborate on secure coding practices.
* Conduct security scoping and onboarding assessments, including vulnerability scans, penetration testing, and risk analysis.
* Review customer SADDs, AWS environments, REST APIs, and orchestration workflows for security posture and compliance gaps.
* Manage onboarding security projects via ServiceNow and coordinate with cross\-functional security teams.
* Monitor security events using Splunk, configure WAF policies, and track findings/projects through Jira.
* Maintain documentation for security configurations, assessments, and onboarding activities.


**What We’re Seeking**
* Bachelor's degree and 2\+ years in a Cyber Security Engineering role, enterprise technology design and support.
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS (IAM, VPC, Security Groups, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Config).
* Solid development and scripting skills in Python and/or Shell; ability to read code across languages (Java, REST/JSON).
* Experience reviewing SADDs and performing security scoping and risk assessments.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, and orchestration platforms (PLOR, DMP) from a security perspective.
* Proficiency with Splunk for security monitoring and log analysis.
* Experience with Jira for security issue tracking and WAF configuration and management.
* Strong working knowledge of Linux environments.
* Understanding of penetration testing and vulnerability assessment methodologies.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
* Knowledge of security frameworks (OWASP, NIST, CIS, ISO 27001\).
* Excellent communication skills, high initiative, and strong follow\-through.
* Knowledge of ITIL concepts including incident, change, and problem management.


**Our Offer to You**
* An inclusive culture strongly reflects our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits, and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee with employee resource groups and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

title: Passionate UE Game Developers
description:
**Desktop VR Game / Level\-D Flight Sims / 20\-G Human Centrifuge / Rehearsing Op\-Sindhoor 2\.0 / ISRO’s Manned Space Flight** 




**The Axial Aero Connection** 




 From the viscerally immersive Raycaster game in 1993 to modern day flight simulators (that render every blade of grass and every bump on the runway) all have one thing in common
 **\- the passion of a Game developer.** 




 Unreal Engine developers at Axial Aero are such passionate creators. Except that the visualisation is now 330\-degree spherically curved screen or VR/MR/XR, the terrain is georeferenced, the cockpit or the space\-vehicle moves 360\-degrees…sometimes at 10\+G force (with our patent pending electro\-mechanical design).
 
 And the pilot or the astronaut inside is an active\-duty officer whose muscle memory depends on how real you render it and how responsive the render is.
 



 At Axial Aero, UE5 isn't a game engine, it's the visual nervous system of a full\-motion flight simulator. The Image Generator (IG) you build locks in sub\-frame sync with complex motion platforms running at physical G\-loads dodging BVR missiles. The terrain you render is the same terrain that a pilot will fly inches above the ground at super\-sonic speeds during actual missions. The weather you simulate is the weather that kills. Every shader, every LOD decision, every frame budget trade\-off has a direct consequence: does this crew member return home from a real mission, or not?
 



*If you've spent your career building Games that you wish were real….this is where what you build actually plays out in real life.* 




  
 



**Unreal Engine Developer – Visual Systems \& Image Generation** 




  
 



 📍 
 **Location:** 
 \[Onsite] – Hyderabad / Bengaluru
 



 🕐 
 **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



 📅 
 **Experience:** 
 5\+ Years
 



 🎮 
 **Domain:** 
 Game\-development / Aviation Simulation / Un\-real / XR / C\+\+
 



  
 



  





**About Axial Aero** 




 We build next\-generation full\-motion, full\-mission simulation platforms \- for fighter pilots pulling high\-G manoeuvres, helicopter pilots doing nape\-of\-earth flying, commercial pilots running emergency procedures, and astronauts training for space flight. Machines that don't just
 *look* 
 like the real thing but
 *feel* 
 like it. It means centrifugal forces a pilot physically experiences. 6\-DOF and multi\-axis 360\-degree rotation platforms driven by safety\-critical embedded software. And it also means immersive projection and XR environments blending real\-time physics \- whether you're modelling a fighter cockpit, a chopper, a commercial airliner, a missile or a spacecraft crew station.
 



 We're a small, deeply technical team moving fast. People here own problems end\-to\-end: from scene architecture to CIGI protocol integration to what a crew member sees through the HUD. If you've spent your career waiting to work on something genuinely challenging, exciting and meaningful \- this is it.
 



  
 



  





**What You'll Be Building** 




 You will be part of a truly multi\-disciplinary team, sharing knowledge on materials, mechanical designs, electronics, aerodynamics, aero\-engines, human physiology, aviation medicine, firmware, weapons, electronic warfare, software and AI.
 



 Your primary focus will be building and maintaining the
 **Unreal Engine 5 Image Generator (IG)** 
 at the heart of Axial Aero's simulation platform \- a field\-deployable system intended for pilot training and operational readiness exercises. You will own the visual pipeline from CIGI protocol integration through to frame delivery, ensuring the rendered world and beyond (Cosmos) matches both the physics engine and the physical motion of the platform in real time.
 



 Depending on the programme, this work may also open doors that very few engineers get access to: restricted civil and military aerospace facilities, direct interaction with operators in the field, and the kind of feedback on your work that you can only get from people who've actually flown the aircraft or trained for space orbit. You may also have the privilege of interacting with decorated soldiers and officers of the Indian armed forces.
 



 If you have a passion for
 **real\-time rendering, immersive simulation, and aviation training** 
 and the patriotism to contribute to Bharat's Aatmanirbharata \- this is the perfect role for you.
 



  
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**CIGI Integration \& Image Generation** 




 •       
 **Implement and maintain a CIGI Host\-to\-IG pipeline** 
 within UE5, parsing real\-time CIGI 3\.3\+ messages for entity control, terrain queries, and sensor effects
 



 •       
 **Synchronise the UE5 visual state** 
 with FDM SDK physics output \- zero frame desync, zero jitter tolerance, sub\-millisecond latency
 



 •       Build and manage
 **entity spawning, LOD control, and sensor view rendering** 
 driven by CIGI message streams
 



**Real\-Time Rendering \& Optimisation** 




 •       Design and maintain a
 **60\+ fps rendering pipeline** 
 meeting full\-dome projection need (330° curved display, multi\-channel output)
 



 •       Own
 **frame budget management** 
 : GPU profiling, draw call reduction, shader complexity, Nanite/Lumen configuration for simulator use cases
 



 •       Implement
 **dynamic weather, visibility, time\-of\-day, and atmospheric rendering** 
 that match real\-world operational conditions
 



 •       Optimise for
 **multi\-GPU and multi\-channel output** 
 (display, clustered rendering, edge blending)
 



**Terrain, GIS \& Environment** 




 •       Integrate
 **georeferenced terrain data** 
 (DTED, GeoTIFF, OBJ/FBX exports) into UE5 with precision coordinate alignment
 



 •       Build
 **high\-fidelity airfields, landmarks, and operational area environments (real terrorist hide\-outs)** 
 \- accurate enough to be mission\-critical
 



 •       Collaborate with GIS teams to sync terrain tile streaming with real\-time sensor logic
 



**Cockpit \& HUD Systems** 




 •       Develop or integrate
 **virtual cockpit instrument systems** 
 \- MFDs, HUDs, FLIRs, EFIS panels \- responding to live simulation state
 



 •       Build
 **XR/VR overlay systems** 
 for immersive training scenarios, including physiological disorientation simulation (spatial disorientation, visual illusions)
 



 •       Interface with the
 **Instructor Operating System (IOS)** 
 to inject real\-time scenario triggers into the visual environment
 



**Systems Integration \& Collaboration**

 **CIGI\-IG and FDM\-visual integration**

 **modular, testable, maintainable UE5 plugin code**

**Tech Stack \& Tools**

 systems

title: FileNet Administrator Jr
description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Expert Labs, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact. Success in Expert Labs is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Delivery Consultant for Expert Labs Data Platform, you will play a key role in implementing and delivering solutions to customers. Your expertise will enable customers to successfully integrate solutions into their operations. Your primary responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Deploy, configure, and administer IBM FileNet Content Manager and related components (Content Engine, Process Engine, Workplace/Workplace XT, Content Navigator).
* Work with clients to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical specifications for FileNet solutions.
* Develop and implement content models, metadata structures, workflows, and security configurations.
* Install and support IBM FileNet in various environments, including development, test, and production.
* Perform system integrations with external applications using APIs, web services, or IBM\-supplied integration tools.
* Troubleshoot system issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and apply necessary fixes.
* Support data migration from legacy systems into FileNet repositories.
* Optimize system performance and ensure scalability according to client needs.
* Prepare technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and deployment plans.
* Collaborate with project managers, business analysts, and client IT teams throughout project lifecycle.
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to client administrators and end users.
* Adhere to IBM standards, industry best practices, and security/compliance guidelines.


**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Hands\-on experience deploying and configuring IBM FileNet Content Manager or other IBM ECM (Enterprise Content Management) tools.
* Strong knowledge of FileNet architecture, including Content Engine, Process Engine, and application components.
* Experience with WebSphere Application Server or equivalent application server technologies.
* Proficiency with relational databases such as DB2, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Familiarity with Linux or Windows server environments.

title: Consultant - Cloud Infra & AI
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solution \- Global Center for Innovation and Delivery (GCID) delivers end\-to\-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000\+ exceptional people, MS GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles. The ideal consultant is passionate about technology, has breadth rather than specific product depth, and has the drive and courage to articulate and stand up for a great solution delivering true value for the client.
   

  

 As a Microsoft consultant, you will deliver quality engagements with your expertise, either as an advisor, reviewer, contributor, or resource in high profile projects to ensure customer value. The ideal candidate must have the ability to combine their technical skills, creativity, and customer focus to deliver great solutions to the customers and ensure they get the best out of our technologies and solutions. Consulting Delivery professionals bring subject matter and solution expertise to architectural teams, customers, and partners. They apply deep technical and business knowledge to accelerate the adoption of Microsoft devices and services by ensuring strategic, architectural, and operational alignment to customer and partner
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* As a full Stack Infrastructure Consultant, design, build, and optimize endtoend cloud and onpremises infrastructure solutions, ensuring secure, scalable, and highperforming environments across the entire technology stack.
* Responsible for technical quality assurance, identification, and mitigation of technical risk across customer or partner deliverables delivery technology strategy aligned solutions
* Applies technical experience and industry\-specific knowledge to develop solutions, based on an analysis of how the proposed approach affects the business objectives of customers and partners.
* Applies information\-compliance and assurance policies to ensure stakeholder confidence.
* Identifies new processes and innovations to help customers or partners build and accelerate capabilities by using Microsoft technologies.
* Identifies the best practice approach for a project, across a wide scope of technical issues, and develops or reuses intellectual capital with customers, world\-wide, and for programs and initiatives across Microsoft.
* Defines engagements and opportunities to use Intellectual Property (IP) and address product gaps, while leveraging existing IP and community resources to ensure consistency and improve predictability.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-10 years of industry experience with a minimum of 3\+ years of Azure Infrastructure experience
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience; advanced technical certifications or higher education preferred.
* Mandatory Microsoft Azure Administrator certification (AZ104\); Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ305\) highly preferred.
* Terraform Associate certification strongly valued, with proven experience in InfrastructureasCode (IaC) automation.
* Cloud AI certification such as Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI‑900\) or equivalent is a strong advantage, with practical understanding of AI/ML workloads on cloud platforms.
* Experience across both application architecture and cloud infrastructure domains, with the ability to bridge development and operations teams effectively.


 AI First Infrastructure Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in Python for automation, AI integration, and scripting across infra workflows
* Experience with Azure AI Services (AI Foundry, AI Agent services, Azure AI Search, Vision, Speech, Translation,) leveraged as infrastructure components for applications
* Understanding of containerized AI workloads with strong hands\-on expertise in AI Developer Tools from Microsoft\- Visual Studio, GitHub Copilot, Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Foundry or similar third\-party
* Ability to integrate OpenAI/Frontier models into cloud environments with secure and scalable infrastructure patterns (from applied AI delivery examples)


 Azure Cloud Strategy, Networking and Devops
   

  

 Cloud Strategy \& Architecture
   

  

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft’s Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Proven experience in designing, implementing, and deploying Azure Landing Zones.


 Landing Zone and Networking
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with Azure IaaS and PaaS services across compute, storage, and networking.
* Expertise in deploying business mission\-critical applications on Azure.
* In\-depth knowledge of Azure networking components including VNet, ExpressRoute, vWAN, ingress/egress patterns, and Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs)


 DevOps \& Automation
   

  

* Proficiency in Azure DevOps, including YAML\-based pipeline configuration.
* Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitHub, GitLab, or Jenkins (working knowledge of others is a plus).
* Strong automation skills using ARM templates, Bicep, Terraform, PowerShell, and Azure CLI.
* Experience deploying infrastructure using a modular, reusable approach.


 Multi Cloud Migration \& Modernization
   

  

* Multi\-Cloud Migration experience. Hands\-on experience in AWS or GCP to Azure migration.
* Experience with large\-scale cloud migration projects using tools like Azure Migrate.
* Familiarity with all stages of the migration lifecycle, including assessment, planning, execution, and optimization.
* Experience with container migration and modernization initiatives.


 Infrastructure Security and Zero Trust Practices
   

  

* Strong command of network segmentation, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, VPN/ExpressRoute security, and Zero Trust networking.
* Implement secure connectivity and encrypted network flows across hybrid and cloud environments.
* Implement Azure Policy, Blueprints, governance guardrails, and secure by design patterns.
* Experience in meeting compliance standards and performing cloud security assessments.
* Deploy secure landing zones following CAF \& WAF (Cloud Adoption Framework \& Well‑Architected Framework) principles ensuring governance, resiliency, and secure adoption paths
* Ensuring alignment with industry frameworks like Zero Trust principles


 Consulting \& Delivery Mindset
   

  

* Strong interest in continuous learning and technical certifications
* Curiosity to explore emerging data and AI technologies
* Willingness to receive feedback, grow technical depth, and expand ownership over time
* Demonstrated success in delivering customer\-facing projects in large\-scale enterprise environments
* Experience conducting technical workshops, envisioning sessions, and solution design engagements.
* Exposure to multiple industries and sectors, with the ability to tailor solutions to diverse business needs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Passion for mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Proven adaptability to new technologies and evolving customer requirements.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


 Embody our culture and values

**Job Description**
 Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer I at JPMorgan Chase within the Model Risk Governance \& Review (MRGR) team, you will be developing tools for MRGR Analytics to improve efficiency and reduce duplication of effort, including resource management and cost optimization tools. You will provide support for model reviewers and governance teams in building independent testing and efficiency tools. You will be delivering high\-quality solutions by emphasizing the importance of data controls, testing, user experience and continuously seek input from users to align efforts with their objectives. Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient.
   

  

 Bring your expertise to JPMorganChase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient. MRGR is a global team of modeling experts within the firm’s Risk Management and Compliance organization. The team is responsible for conducting independent model validation and model governance activities to help identify, measure, and mitigate Model Risk in the firm. Within MRGR, the Chief Operating Office (COO) supports model risk stakeholders in their review and governance activities, and drives certain governance activities itself, with responsibility for: product ownership, process engineering and software development for model risk technology and analytics; model risk reporting; administration of oversight committees; project management of the review and governance pipeline; coordination of regulatory/audit deliverables including capital stress testing exercises; and general business management. Within COO, MRGR Analytics provides technology solutions for MRGR and its clients, assisting them in performing their tasks more efficiently, accurately, and with better control. Majority of the solutions are built within Athena (JPMorganChase’s proprietary framework using Python language), Tableau and QlikView/QlikSense frameworks.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop tools to automate various tasks in the model governance and review lifecycle.
* Build various dashboard reports to help manage the body of work that MRGR deals with.
* Translate the existing business requirements in model risk management space into business applications using applied development work mostly in Python using in\-house built Python framework.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into existing systems to enhance automation, reporting capabilities and decision\-making processes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities for LLM integration and develop solutions that leverage LLM capabilities.
* Build intelligent solutions to support the activities of MRGR staff.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* A Bachelors or Masters degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics discipline with significant exposure to computer programming.
* Minimum 2 years of full stack application development.
* Proficient in Python and knowledge of Tornado web framework / TypeScript / React required.
* Good understanding of software architecture, object\-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Experience with integrating machine learning models, including LLMs, into enterprise applications.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interface with other functional areas in the firm on business requirements.
* Risk and control mindset: ability to think critically, assess user needs and create design solutions to meet user needs.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience in working with large data sets.
* Exposure to LLM integration and deployment in real\-world applications.
* Strong UI/UX designing skills.
* Experience in model risk management or financial services space.

 Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

description:
****DESCRIPTION****
 AEE is looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer to work on our expansions tech stacks, which enables to launch new stores with local language, local currency, local payments and build new features and enhancements to work on an S team goal. The expansions strategy, and roadmap is one of the most important initiatives across Amazon. You will design, architect and innovative technology solutions that will reduce time to market, standardize execution and scale for expansion globally. You will build, operate and play a key role in the evolution of our platform to solve the world's most complex technical challenges in Information extraction, Large\-scale computing, Distributed systems, Web applications, Data mining, Scalability, Security, and Algorithms to name a few. You’ll strive for simplicity, and demonstrate significant creativity and high judgment. You will play a key role in stabilizing the day to day operations and improving the platform’s build and testing process, and ensure adherence to organizational software and security compliance.
   

  

 The job is simple: make everything available to everyone all the time at the best possible price. The requirements are almost as simple \- we’re looking for leaders and trailblazers who aren’t afraid of tackling massive scale, layered complexity and ambiguous requirements to empower our customers to shop the World. No two features are ever the same and our customers are hungry for every single one!
   

  

**What To Expect Day\-to\-day:**
* Solve complex problems through data, rapidly.
* Design and develop state of the art software systems that address these complex and ambiguous problems.
* Own the inputs and the business outcome through cultivating a culture of relentless auditing and metric monitoring, automatically where possible.


 This is a contractual position which is ideal for candidates who are looking to deal with scaling challenges at Amazon and ready to build mission critical system software applications and tools. It is also an opportunity for freelance candidates to become domain experts and have an enormous opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture and development of consumer products. Depending on individual performance this experience can lead to permanent positions as Software Development Engineers at Amazon.

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
About T4Tech Vision Pvt. Ltd.

T4Tech Vision Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing system integrator delivering end\-to\-end Audio\-Visual (AV) and IT infrastructure solutions to corporate, education, hospitality, and government clients across India. As we scale our operations, we are looking for a driven Senior HR Executive to strengthen our people function and help build a high\-performance culture.

Role Overview:

***Looking for someone who is ambitious, takes ownership, and want to learn and grow with the company.***

The Senior HR Executive will be a key contributor to our HR function, handling three critical pillars: Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition, Generalist HR Operations, and Payroll \& Compliance. You will work closely with department heads to attract top talent, ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR operations, and maintain full statutory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Experience and hiring sales people.
* Develop and post compelling job descriptions across job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed) and social media.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for technical (AV/IT/Hardware) and non\-technical roles.
* Coordinate with department heads to understand manpower requirements and create job profiles.
* Negotiate and extend offer letters; manage pre\-joining formalities and documentation.
* Drive campus hiring and referral programs to reduce time\-to\-hire.
* Track and report recruitment metrics: TAT, offer\-to\-joining ratio, cost\-per\-hire.

2\. Generalist HR Operations

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, and procedures.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the HRMS system.
* Manage the employee lifecycle: confirmation, transfers, promotions, separations, and exit interviews.
* Coordinate performance appraisal cycles, goal\-setting, and feedback documentation.
* Implement and communicate HR policies, employee handbooks, and SOPs.
* Organize employee engagement initiatives, team events, and R\&R (Rewards \& Recognition) programs.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and escalate complex issues to management.

3\. Payroll \& Compliance

* Process monthly payroll accurately and ensure timely salary disbursement in coordination with Finance.
* Manage statutory compliance: PF, ESIC, PT, TDS, Gratuity, and Bonus as per applicable laws.
* Prepare and file returns for PF, ESIC, and PT with relevant government portals.
* Maintain compliance registers and records as required under the Shops \& Establishments Act, Labour Laws, and other applicable regulations.
* Issue salary slips, Form 16, experience letters, and other employment documentation.
* Stay updated on changes in labour laws and ensure timely policy updates.

Qualifications \& SkillsEducation

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources (preferred) or Bachelor's degree in any discipline with relevant HR experience.

Experience

* 3–5 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in a technology, system integrator, or services company.
* Proven track record in handling recruitment for technical profiles (Engineers, AV/IT Specialists).
* Hands\-on experience with payroll processing and statutory compliance.

Technical Skills

* Proficiency in HRMS/HRIS platforms (e.g., GreytHR, Keka, Zoho People, or similar).
* Working knowledge of payroll software and government compliance portals (EPFO, ESIC, MCA).
* Proficient in MS Office Suite: Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), Word, and PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with job portals: Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, Shine.

Soft Skills

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal).
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work under deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Detail\-oriented with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary package commensurate with experience.
* A dynamic, collaborative, and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to build and shape the HR function in a growing organization.
* Exposure to diverse hiring across technical, AV, and business functions.
* Professional development and upskilling support.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

title: Outbound Sales Representative
description:
**About Us:**

Welcome to WisdmLabs, where fresh minds meet experienced mentors! We are a dynamic web agency that believes in nurturing talent from day one. If you're a recent graduate excited about web development and curious about AI tools (don't worry, we'll teach you!), this is your perfect starting point. Join our supportive team environment where learning is encouraged, mistakes are part of growth, and your potential is our priority.

**Position Summary:**

We're looking for someone who genuinely wants to hit the ground running \- not shadow someone, not fill a spreadsheet, but actively contribute to how we grow. In this role, you'll speak with real prospects, run outbound campaigns, and create content that has a clear job: start conversations, earn attention, and bring the right people closer to us. You'll be working with AI as an active part of your workflow \- using it to research, draft, personalise, and move faster without losing quality. You'll get a firsthand sense of how pipelines get built, what makes people respond, and how marketing and outreach come together to move a business forward. You'll have full ownership of what you work on \- and a team that's always up for a brainstorm or to help you think through a jam. If you get excited about crafting a cold email that actually gets a reply, or figuring out why a LinkedIn post pulled in 10x the usual reach, this role is for you.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Research and build targeted prospect lists across industries, personas, and segments relevant to our ideal customer profile
* Write, send, iterate, and analyse outbound sequences \- cold emails and LinkedIn DMs \- tracking open rates, reply rates, and meetings booked
* Own social media execution across LinkedIn and Instagram \- posts, carousels, short\-form content that attract and warm up the right audience. We'll also experiment with faceless AI\-first video accounts
* Turn customer wins, product updates, free tools, and internal inputs into outreach hooks, social proof assets, and content \- things that give prospects a genuine reason to engage
* Use AI tools actively \- for prospecting, personalising outreach, drafting copy, and improving messaging

**What we're looking for:**

* Strong written communication \- clarity, intent, and a sense of who you're writing for
* A genuine curiosity about people \- what drives them, what frustrates them, what they actually want
* A bias toward figuring things out on your own first \- you'll ask Google or AI before you ask a person
* Comfort with AI tools, or a strong eagerness to get there fast
* Organised and consistent \- you can manage a list, follow up, and track what's working

**Who will do well in this role:**

* You find human behaviour genuinely interesting \- and that curiosity shows up in how you write and who you write to
* You pay attention to the marketing you experience as a user \- what made you open, stop, or respond \- and you think about why
* You were active in college clubs, fests, or student initiatives, and you bring that same energy to your work
* You hit a wall and find a way around it before asking someone to move it

**Why join us:**

* You'll be doing real work from day one \- outreach, content, campaigns \- not busywork
* You'll get direct access to prospects and clients, which is rare this early in a career
* You'll learn how outbound and social work together in practice, not in theory
* You'll build a body of work \- campaigns, sequences, content \- that you can actually point to
* You'll be part of a small team that takes your ideas seriously

description:
**Job Title:** Sr. Manager, Engineering
**Posting Start Date:** 6/1/26
**Job Location(s):** Bengaluru
If you are looking for a challenging and exciting career in the world of technology, then look no further. Skyworks is an innovator of high performance analog semiconductors whose solutions are powering the wireless networking revolution. At Skyworks, you will find a fast\-paced environment with a strong focus on global collaboration, minimal layers of management and the freedom to make meaningful contributions in a setting that encourages creativity and out\-of\-the\-box thinking. We are excited about the opportunity to work with you and glad you want to be part of a team of talented individuals who together can change the way the world communicates.



Requisition ID: 77661


**Job Description:****Description**



The candidate will help staff, and lead MSB’s Analog/RF Design Team in Bengaluru with a mission of building a strong team focused on RF/Analog IC design. This team will be a key part of our Mobile Solutions Business, which consists of highly integrated front end modules that integrate Filters, Switches, LNAs, and matching in densely packed \& complex front\-end modules for Cellular and WiFi applications. The team will work directly and closely with design teams in the US.

  



As the Analog/RF manager, you will be responsible for a team of engineers driving IC block\-level designs and layout. You and your team will engage in frequent technical meetings and design reviews with chip leads and counterparts abroad.

  



In this position, you have the opportunity to make uniquely large impact on the success of the company and will have visibility at the highest levels of the company.

  



We are looking for a passion to win/contribute and ability to work in, and thrive in, a fast\-paced dynamic team environment.

**Responsibilities**



The candidate will report to the Engineering Director locally and have a team of Engineers reporting to them. These Engineers will have a matrix reporting structure to various teams in US doing IC design.

  



Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:



* Recruiting \& Staffing:


* + Jointly drive staffing \& recruiting with HR to ensure a world\-class team is brought together to execute on complex, highly critical programs.
* Technical Leadership:

	+ Act as the IC Design \& Technical Leader for a team focused on the design of complex front\- end modules

	+ Experience managing large technical teams

	+ A track record of growing successful design teams

	+ Ability to set \& articulate clear goals and drive accountability to those

	+ Use of AI tools to improve productivity, efficiency, automation, bug\-tracking and reporting
* Communication:

	+ Drive company communications, strategy, and goals via team meetings and regular 1:1 and reporting to chip leads and managers in the US.
* Travel to US will be required from time to time


**Required Experience and Skills**


* The candidate must have excellent written and spoken communications, sufficient to present program technical status \& schedule progress to senior management.


* EDA \& Software tools:

	+ Strong experience with the Cadence suite of EDA tools

	+ Knowledge of commonly used IC layout tools

	+ Knowledge of 2D/3D EM simulation tools

	+ Experience with PVT and statistical simulations
* Circuit Design:

	+ Broad and deep expertise in core Analog Design including low bit count data converters (ADC \& DAC blocks), Bandgaps, Op\-Amps, Bias blocks, Charge\-pumps, Temp sensor, Clock and timing, LDO, ESD, e\-fuse and other supporting cells.

	+ Good understanding of RF SOI technology including RF switch, tuning \& RF LNA design.

	+ Basic Digital Design including SPI \& MIPI interface design, Decoding logic, and simple state machines.

	+ Semiconductor process knowledge including SOI, bulk CMOS, SiGe.

	+ Must understand the basic device physics, ability to develop and use advanced linear and nonlinear models or simulation techniques and be able to translate between the model, simulation, physical implementation, and the measured performance of a device

  


* Working knowledge of RF multi\-chip modules including 3D Packaging, assembly, thermals and EMI basics.



Knowledge of test equipment and common tests and parameters

**Minimum Requirements**



Minimum Requirements:

  

* + BSEE; MS preferred

	+ 10\+ years of IC Design experience

	+ 6\+ years of Technical Leadership and Management experience

title: Manager - HRBP
description:
About the Company
 
 Eva Bharat is building India's largest network of Digital Out\-of\-Home (DOOH) and 3D billboard advertising infrastructure. Through a technology\-driven platform, we help brands launch and manage impactful outdoor advertising campaigns across a rapidly expanding network of digital screens and media assets.
 



  





 At Eva Bharat, we operate at the intersection of technology, advertising, media, and innovation. Our mission is to modernize outdoor advertising through scalable solutions, creative storytelling, and data\-driven campaign execution.
 



  





 As a fast\-growing startup, we believe people and culture are the foundation of our growth. We are now looking for a strategic and execution\-focused HRBP – Manager to help strengthen our people operations, employee engagement, hiring strategy, and organizational culture.
 



  




 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an experienced and proactive HRBP – Manager who can work closely with leadership and different business functions to drive organizational growth through effective HR practices.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in HR operations, employee relations, performance management, talent acquisition coordination, policy implementation, and people strategy. This role requires someone who can balance strategic thinking with day\-to\-day execution in a fast\-paced startup environment.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 * Partner with leadership teams to align HR strategies with business goals.
* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, engagement, performance management, and exit formalities.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and help build a high\-performance work culture.
* Support hiring teams in workforce planning, talent acquisition coordination, and organizational structuring.
* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, and employee processes.
* Handle employee relations, conflict resolution, and workplace concerns professionally.
* Monitor employee performance frameworks, KPIs, and appraisal cycles.
* Maintain HR documentation, compliance records, and operational processes.
* Work closely with department managers to identify training and development needs.
* Build scalable HR systems and processes suitable for a rapidly growing startup environment.
* Ensure smooth communication between employees, managers, and leadership teams.



  




 Requirements
 * Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be preferred.
* 3–6 years of experience in HRBP, HR Operations, or HR Generalist roles.
* Strong understanding of HR processes, employee engagement, and organizational development.
* Experience working in startups, media, advertising, technology, or fast\-paced organizations is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, HRMS platforms, and reporting tools.
* Strong ownership mindset and execution capabilities.



  




 Preferred Skills
 * Experience in scaling teams in startup environments.
* Knowledge of performance management systems and HR analytics.
* Understanding of organizational culture\-building initiatives.
* Exposure to recruitment strategy and employer branding.
* Ability to create structured HR frameworks from scratch.



  




 What We Offer
 * Opportunity to work directly with leadership in a rapidly growing startup.
* High ownership and decision\-making exposure.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Fast career growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to shape organizational culture and HR systems.
* Competitive salary and performance\-driven growth.
* Learning\-focused and innovation\-driven workplace.

title: HR Manager
description:
**Description**
 Leidos is seeking an experienced and strategic HR Manager to support our growing operations in India. This role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders and employees, ensuring compliance with Indian employment legislation while driving employee engagement, organizational effectiveness, talent management, and workforce planning initiatives.
   

  

 The HR Manager will partner closely with the HR EMEAI Lead, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, International Payroll, Finance, and business leaders to deliver HR programs that support business objectives, foster a positive workplace culture, and enhance the employee experience across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 This position requires a hands\-on HR professional with strong business acumen, deep knowledge of Indian employment laws and statutory requirements, and the ability to balance strategic partnership with operational execution in a fast\-paced, global environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**HR Business Partnership**
* Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, providing proactive HR guidance and support across the employee lifecycle.
* Partner with business leaders to support workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, restructures, and talent management initiatives.
* Support the implementation of regional and global HR strategies within India, ensuring alignment with business objectives and local requirements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support business objectives and people outcomes.
* Coach and influence managers on leadership effectiveness, employee development, performance management, and organizational best practices.


**Employee Relations \& Workplace Culture**
* Foster a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace culture aligned with Leidos values and business objectives.
* Lead and manage employee relations matters, including performance management, disciplinary actions, grievances, investigations, and capability issues.
* Promote employee wellbeing, engagement, retention, and workplace satisfaction initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, equality standards, health and safety requirements, and employee welfare programs.
* Drive initiatives that strengthen organizational culture, employee engagement, and workplace effectiveness.


**Talent Acquisition \& Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Support managers with recruitment, onboarding, development, retention, and offboarding activities.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition to support hiring strategies, workforce growth initiatives, and talent pipeline planning.
* Prepare employment contracts and related employment documentation while providing guidance on terms, conditions, and employment best practices.
* Coordinate employment\-related administration, including right\-to\-work verification, visa applications, and airport pass requirements where applicable.
* Ensure a seamless and positive employee experience throughout all stages of the employment lifecycle.


**Compensation, Benefits \& Payroll**
* Support the design, implementation, and administration of compensation and reward programs, including pay structures, annual salary review cycles, employee compensation adjustments, and reward initiatives.
* Manage compensation\-related employee lifecycle activities including promotions, role changes, and organizational restructures, ensuring alignment with internal governance, compensation philosophy, and market practices.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, International Payroll, Finance, and business leaders to provide compensation insights, analytics, and recommendations that support hiring, promotions, retention strategies, workforce planning, and broader talent decisions.
* Support the administration and review of in\-country benefits programs while monitoring external market trends, competitive practices, and pay positioning to ensure continued market competitiveness.
* Coordinate monthly payroll submissions and ensure compliance with HR Shared Services processes and timelines.
* Work closely with the International Payroll Manager to ensure payroll practices comply with applicable Indian labor laws, tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain strong controls over compensation and employee data integrity, ensuring governance\-ready documentation, remuneration summaries, audit support, reporting accuracy, and leadership reporting requirements.
* Support salary review processes, wage administration, performance management programs, and employee reward initiatives.


**Compliance \& HR Operations**
* Develop, implement, maintain, and communicate HR policies and procedures in compliance with Indian employment legislation and company requirements.
* Ensure HR records, training documentation, and HR systems are maintained accurately and in accordance with regulatory and organizational requirements.
* Monitor employee absence trends and support effective attendance management practices.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable employment laws, statutory obligations, and company policies.
* Stay current on changes to Indian labor legislation and advise leaders on compliance implications and required actions.
* Support audits, reporting requirements, and regulatory compliance activities.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**
* Work collaboratively with regional HR teams, Centers of Excellence, Shared Services, and business leaders to deliver consistent HR solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, systems, compliance practices, and employee experience.
* Support HR projects and strategic initiatives across the EMEAI region.
* Undertake additional responsibilities consistent with the scope and level of the role.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant experience in an HR Generalist, HR Business Partner, or HR Manager capacity.
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law, statutory compliance requirements, payroll regulations, and HR best practices.
* Strong understanding of Indian organizational culture, workforce practices, and employment frameworks.
* Proven experience supporting multi\-state operations and ensuring compliance with both national and state\-specific labor regulations.
* Prior experience developing, revising, and implementing HR policies and procedures aligned with business objectives, organizational needs, and local labor regulations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing HR programs across employee relations, performance management, compensation, benefits, talent management, and organizational development.
* Experience supporting compensation planning, salary review cycles, employee compensation actions, and market benchmarking activities.
* Demonstrated experience influencing and partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization.
* Experience supporting payroll processes and working with HRIS platforms.
* Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and HR systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a regional and global HR team.


**Employment Law, Payroll \& Compliance Expertise**
**The Successful Candidate Will Possess**
- Deep understanding of Indian employment legislation and statutory compliance requirements, including:

* Code on Wages, 2019
* Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)
* Employee State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax (PT)
* Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
* Demonstrated ability to partner closely with International Payroll and Finance teams to ensure compliance with payroll, taxation, statutory reporting obligations, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong knowledge of gratuity calculations and administration, maternity benefit requirements, statutory bonus obligations, and other employee benefit programs mandated under Indian law.
* Working knowledge of regional labor law requirements, including state\-specific Shops and Establishments Acts and other local employment regulations across India.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting U.S.\-based multinational organizations and operating within global HR governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting multinational, matrixed, or global organizations.
* Exposure to HR practices across EMEAI or other international regions.
* Professional HR certification such as SHRM\-CP/SCP, HRCI, CIPD, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting government, aerospace, defense, engineering, technology, or professional services organizations.


**What You'll Bring**
* Strategic thinking combined with strong operational execution.
* A collaborative and consultative approach to HR partnership.
* The ability to influence and advise leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strong business acumen and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* A passion for creating positive employee experiences and fostering an inclusive workplace culture.
* Commitment to integrity, compliance, and organizational excellence.


**Why Leidos**
 At Leidos, we are committed to creating a workplace where innovation, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion drive our success. We value diverse perspectives and empower our employees to make meaningful contributions to our customers, communities, and each other.
   

  

 All employees are expected to uphold our corporate values, demonstrate the highest ethical standards, and contribute to a culture of respect, inclusion, collaboration, and accountability.
   

  

 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
   

  

**Original Posting**
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.
   

  

**Pay Range**
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
   

  

**About Leidos**
 Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16\.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025\. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
 Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay\-benefits.
   

  

**Securing Your Data**
 Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment\-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment\-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.
   

  

 If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
   

  

**Commitment to Non\-Discrimination**
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Leidos will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with relevant laws.
